metadata.case_name: LAU CHE PING v. HOI KONG IRONWARES GODOWN COMPANY LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: welder and general labourer (employed by the Defendant Company in its scrap metal yard in Tuen Mun)
plaintiff.occupation_after: returned briefly to employment with the Defendant Company; subsequently engaged in pigeon breeding for about eighteen months

injuries.description: below knee amputation of left leg arising from severe crush injury to left foot
source: the Plaintiff's left foot was very badly crushed and contaminated.
that the wound was so badly infected that a below knee amputation would have to be performed. That was done on 4th July.

After a period of convalescence he was on 17th July sent to the Margaret Trench Medical Rehabilitation Centre in Kwun Tong where an artificial leg or prosthesis ass fitted. After about ten weeks' training in that centre he was able to use and walk independently on his new artificial leg and he was discharged on 5th October.
injuries.icd_description: Traumatic amputation at level between left knee and ankle

manifestations.description: walks at a much slower pace than before, and with a decided limp
problems with stairs and public transport
can wear the prosthesis for about one or two hours at a time, after which he feels pain in his stump
if he continues to use the prosthesis for longer periods of time then the stump becomes abrased and sore
completely unable to participate in recreational pastimes such as the ball games usually played by youngsters in the parks and streets of Hong Kong

treatments_received: rehabilitation training at Margaret Trench Medical Rehabilitation Centre (about ten weeks)

losses.description: Walks at a much slower pace with a decided limp; problems with stairs and public transport; limited ability to wear prosthesis (1-2 hours) due to pain and abrasion of stump

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Completely unable to participate in recreational pastimes such as ball games previously enjoyed
